description: Check an ApexGantt options object against what the library does with it (missing id/name, numeric ids, tasks missing the dates the library requires, a missing endTime with no type (a milestone from 3.20.0, a throw before), a parent with only one date (a summary bar from 3.20.0, a throw before), an unknown task type, an incomplete `parsing` map, duplicate ids, orphan parentId, parentId cycles, progress out of 0 to 100, ISO dates with the default MM-DD-YYYY format, dependency object using `id` instead of `taskId`, unknown dependency target, self-dependency, invalid dependency type, `lagUnit` (no effect), dependency cycles, baseline missing start/end, `calendar.workingWeekdays` naming no weekday, tokens / designSystem that are not booleans). Returns structured issues with stable rule ids.

config.description: The ApexGantt options object to validate.

name: apexgantt_validate_config
title: Validate ApexGantt config
